name: GE360 Core
description: Discover, inspect and call the local GE360 HTTP API with guarded write access and no arbitrary remote URL support.
progressive_guidance: Use discoverLocalService/diagnose when the address is unknown. Prefer discoverResources, listResource and getResource over guessing paths. GET is VERDE. POST/PUT/PATCH are GIALLA unless promoted to ROSSA by action semantics. DELETE and send/publish/campaign/payment-like operations are ROSSA. Never bypass owner approval with shell, curl, browser automation or direct database writes.

discoverLocalService.description: Probe configured and common localhost addresses to find a GE360 HTTP service and identify its API surface.

diagnose.description: Check GE360 connectivity, health endpoints and OpenAPI availability and return a compact diagnostic summary.

getOpenAPI.description: Fetch the GE360 OpenAPI document and return API metadata plus a compact list of available paths and methods.

request.description: Call a relative GE360 API path under the JARVIS safety policy. GET is automatic; write operations may require one-time owner approval.

path.description: Relative GE360 path beginning with /, for example /api/clienti.

discoverResources.description: Discover real GE360 collection/detail endpoints for known modules from the backend OpenAPI document.

listResource.description: List a known GE360 resource using the best matching real GET collection endpoint discovered from OpenAPI.

getResource.description: Get one known GE360 resource by id using the best matching real GET detail endpoint discovered from OpenAPI.
